sources.title: INFOMATION
sources.snippet: 株式会社AJAXは、2025年11月20日(木)〜21日(金)に浜松町館で開催される フィジタル知育ゲーム 「RollingSeeds(ローリングシーズ)」 を出展いたします。

sources.title: タブレット学習の「孤独」を解消。“手で触れる”フィジタル知育ゲーム ...

Rolling Seeds is a fantastic edutainment gaming platform that provides hours of fun and learning for the whole family. The selection of games and puzzles is diverse and engaging. I appreciate how the platform seamlessly blends entertainment with education

Mrs. Williams

### Outstanding interactive product for families with children [...] RollingSeeds is a kids' streaming platform that turns passive screen time into active, hands-on play. Our app features a library of beautifully animated storybooks — and every episode comes with interactive quiz questions. Kids use physical Seeds tokens or a virtual keyboard to roll, tap, and answer quizzes, building real comprehension and fine motor skills. It's the first streaming service that bridges the digital and physical worlds.

How does RollingSeeds make screen time better? + [...] As a parent, I'm always eager to find something we can all do together as a family, but, let's face it, it's tough..this rolling seeds game is excellent at bringing us all together.

Hae Won Jung
